usage.costNote: Estimated cost = requests × published unit price; your provider’s bill is what counts. Some providers don’t report prices — those show “—”.
usage.runnerExplain: Generations that run on ANTEI’s own machines (such as LoRA images) are paid for by ANTEI, not your keys: {limit} per person per month, resetting {date}. The quota counts generation jobs; the ANTEI Runner row above counts every request (including failures and retries), so the two numbers differ.
usage.runnerExplainExempt: Generations that run on ANTEI’s own machines (such as LoRA images) are paid for by ANTEI, not your keys. Your account has no monthly limit; the count resets {date}.

assistantSkills.character-profiles: Research canon sources and write a character profile: identity, behavior, speech, backstory.
assistantSkills.danbooru-character-tags: Find and verify a character’s Danbooru tag from a Chinese, Japanese or English name.
assistantSkills.framing-and-tiers: Pick aspect ratio, resolution and quality tier from what’s in the picture, plus when to upscale and which model to use.
assistantSkills.lora-mixing: Mounting LoRAs: mixing, weights, trigger words, base families, and reproducing a LoRA example.
assistantSkills.reference-roles: What each reference picture supplies (face, outfit, pose, style), and how to take “only the style”.
assistantSkills.reproduce-and-reverse: Reproduce a picture from its recipe, turn a picture into a prompt, and find where a picture came from online.
assistantSkills.safety-filter-blocks: What to reword after a provider’s safety filter blocked a prompt.
assistantSkills.seedance-prompts: Writing rules for Seedance 2.0 / 2.5 video: lock-in line, one move per shot, cuts, pacing.
assistantSkills.tag-bench-people-and-text: Splitting several people into their own prompts and placing text in the picture on the tag bench.
assistantSkills.tag-model-prompts: Prompts and negatives for tag models (NovelAI, Illustrious, Pony, Anima).
assistantSkills.video-shots-and-dialogue: Video clips: one action per clip, dialogue timing, references, first and last frames.

claudeCode.title: Claude Code
claudeCode.description: Paste a token into Claude Code, Cursor or similar tools and they can browse and organise your library and cut your canvas. Choose how far each token can go.
